technicalAssessment.variant: Basic OG buggy self-arm/own-leg structure; teaching and partnered instants, not a claim that both frames use an identical terminal hand configuration.
technicalAssessment.differentiation: A recognizable same-person forearm inside the bent own-leg hook is the identity check. Clear sleeve-versus-trouser separation at that one route is required; exposing every hidden fingertip, ankle or far arm is not.
technicalAssessment.evidenceBoundary: The 01:30 image isolates the same self-hook; 02:36 supplies the partnered enclosure. Combining them is a source-grounded illustrative synthesis, not one photograph that simultaneously exposes every finish detail.
technicalAssessment.prohibitedInference: Do not turn an occluded wrist into a specific ankle grab, invent a terminal grip, claim that v5 was definitely anatomically wrong, or use the prompt's production goal as evidence that a later candidate passes.

generationRecommendation.exactPromptEnglish: Create one representative OG buggy-choke illustration, using reference 1 for the TWO-PERSON BODY ARRANGEMENT, reference 2 only for the OWN-ARM/OWN-LEG MECHANISM, and the final neutral portrait only for character identity and rendering style. In reference 1 the curly-haired BLACK/YELLOW bottom demonstrator becomes the WHITE-HAIRED man in a complete BLUE gi; the kneeling striped-rashguard top partner becomes the BLACK-HAIRED man in a complete WHITE gi. Preserve this source camera: top WHITE is perpendicular across bottom BLUE, with his two independent knees/shins supporting him; BLUE is folded underneath, with his own bent leg raised beside/above WHITE's upper body. At the defining junction, BLUE's sleeved arm must visibly pass INSIDE the bend of BLUE's OWN folded knee/calf and connect into the compact arm-leg loop. Reference 2 isolates that same self-arm/own-leg hook without the opponent: its striped-rashguard solo demonstrator represents BLUE for this MECHANICAL DETAIL ONLY, not a third person or a different garment assignment. Keep a small readable separation between BLUE sleeve/cuff and BLUE trouser leg at this one junction. Follow reference 1's supported hand silhouette and natural occlusion; do not invent exposed finger placement, ankle grip, or a new finishing grip. Do not retain the previous v5 WHITE near forearm across this junction merely to match the old candidate: use the NEW photographed partner arm placement and camera. Other naturally hidden nonessential contacts may stay hidden. Exactly two adult men, two arms and two legs per person; every WHITE limb belongs to the black-haired WHITE-gi man and every BLUE limb to the white-haired BLUE-gi man, both brown belts and neutral expressions. Match the approved detailed 2.5D anime gi rendering. One square image, 1024x1024 or larger, transparent background, comfortable contour margins, for charcoal #15171E compositing. No floor, matte, diagrams, arrows, panels, lettering, logos or watermark.
